evidence_boundaries: The AWAKE paper reanalyzes earlier experimental schlieren images using formulas trained on simulated signals; it is not a new plasma-channel campaign or universal instrument calibration.
The drift-kinetic PIC work is a derivation and author numerical validation; the intended drift-kinetic-electron plus fully kinetic-ion hybrid and complex geometries are not yet demonstrated.
The grid-instability result is theory plus author PIC tests for a one-dimensional electrostatic cold plasma and cannot be promoted to general multidimensional electromagnetic PIC stability.
The fusion-AI work is an offline heterogeneous-hardware inference benchmark; average latency is not full PCS timing or reactor closed-loop validation.

The copper result directly measures near-threshold thick-target neutron yield, while the 14 MeV enriched-target activity and application rates rely on TALYS/SRIM extrapolation; the local file is not the publisher VOR.
No symbolic-regression training, xpic run, grid-eigenmode calculation, AI deployment, TALYS or SRIM calculation was rerun locally.
